title: Ongoing and Fossil Large-scale Outflows Detected in a High-redshift Radio Galaxy: [C II] Observations of TN J0924-2201 at z = 5.174
question: What are the kinematics of the [C II] gas in the z=5.17 radio galaxy TN J0924-2201, and are the three CO(1-0) companions outflows from the host or unrelated dwarf galaxies?

evidence.quote: The detection of Ly$\alpha$ line ($z_{\rm Ly\alpha}=5.195$) and C iv 1549 Å emission line ($z_{\rm C\,{\sc IV}}=5.184$)

what.value: CO(1-0) detections, ALMA Band 6 photometry, radio fluxes

evidence.quote: ALMA Band 6 (cite: Falkendal19; Lee23) and ALMA Band 7 (this work).

what.value: Stellar mass M*=1.3e11 Msun from SED fitting

evidence.quote: consistent with the SED-derived stellar mass $M_{*}=1.3\times10^{11}\,M_{\odot}$ (cite: DeBreuck10)

what.value: Lya emitters velocities in overdense region

evidence.quote: the velocities of six Ly$\alpha$ emitters in the overdense region around TN J0924$-$2201 reported by (cite: Venemans04)

recipe.method: tclean mtmfs on line-free channels; peak and integrated flux

recipe.goal: Modified blackbody SED fit for T_dust, beta, L_IR
recipe.method: Graybody fit to ALMA Band 6 and 7 data
assumptions: Optically thin above nu_0 = 1.5 THz; synchrotron negligible at 1 mm

recipe.goal: Build [C II] cube and fit line
recipe.method: uvcontsub, tclean hogbom; spectra; single and double 1-D Gaussian fits

recipe.goal: Moment maps, flux, luminosity, inclination, dynamical mass
recipe.method: Moment 0/1/2; 2-D Gaussian fit on moment-0; virial mass M=1.56e6 sigma^2 R
assumptions: Symmetric circular disk for inclination; virialized system

recipe.goal: Test companions with PDR model and escape velocity
recipe.method: Upper limits on L_[CII] (500 km/s width) and L_IR (scaled gray-body); PDRT density/G0; escape velocity of 1e13 Msun halo
assumptions: Companions at 12–33 kpc projected distance with ~1500 km/s velocity

answer_key.quantity: Continuum integrated flux of TN J0924-2201

evidence.quote: The peak flux of TN J0924$-$2201 is $392\pm19\,\mu$Jy and the integrated flux is $829\pm57\,\mu$Jy.
redshifted by a velocity of $1035\pm10$ km s$^{-1}$
C iv line with a velocity of $500\pm10$ km s$^{-1}$
the integrated flux of [C ii] is $3.34\pm0.31\,\rm Jy\,km\,s^{-1}$
we derived its inclination angle of $52.8\pm7.6$ degree.
The $3\sigma$ upper limit of non-detection is $57\,\mu$Jy with beam $\sim0''.4$.
